text: [95] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti dhammapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti niruttipaṭisambhidāppatto hoti paṭibhāṇapaṭisambhidāppatto hoti yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhatīti .
